title: Faster Mixing for Triangulations via Transport Flows
summary: We prove an $\widetilde O(n^2)$ bound for the relaxation time and the log-Sobolev time (inverse log-Sobolev constant) of the classical triangulation flip chain on a convex $(n+2)$-gon, implying a mixing time of $\widetilde O(n^2)$. The previous state of the art for the mixing time of this chain, due to Eppstein and Frishberg, was $\widetilde O(n^3)$, while the best known lower bound on the mixing time, due to Molloy, Reed, and Steiger, is $Ω(n^{3/2})$.
